option_relations.rationale: The option 'Invasive apocrine carcinoma of the breast' is the English translation of the Chinese leaf label '乳腺大汗腺癌'.
Primary acinic cell carcinoma of the breast is a distinct type of breast carcinoma and is not equivalent to or directly related to apocrine carcinoma of the breast.
Mucoepidermoid Carcinoma is a distinct type of carcinoma, often found in salivary glands, and is not equivalent to or directly related to apocrine carcinoma of the breast.
Adenoid cystic carcinoma of the breast is a distinct type of breast carcinoma and is not equivalent to or directly related to apocrine carcinoma of the breast.
